name: Optical sensors and IR parts
summary: Light sensors and IR parts: photodiodes, phototransistors, LDRs, IR LEDs and IR receivers.
identify: IR receivers behind the window of every TV and appliance; slot sensors in printers and mice; LDRs (a squiggly line on the face) in night lights and solar garden lights; IR LEDs in remotes and CCTV cameras.
test: An LDR’s resistance drops in light. A lit IR LED shows a faint purple glow through a phone camera.
